title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Combining Plans on One Property
content:
# Combining Plans on One Property

Enrollment desk standard for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## The rule

Plans on the same property combine only when they cover different lines: a property may hold, for example, a water line plan and an electrical line plan together, and each plan pays its own occurrences under its own caps. A plan is not enrolled when the same property address already has a plan in status waiting period, active or suspended for nonpayment whose covered line types share a line type with the plan requested. A customer moving from single-line plans to a bundle cancels the overlapping plans first, effective the day before the bundle starts; the bundle then serves its own waiting period for lines that were not continuously covered. Line protection plans and home warranty contracts on the same property do not exclude each other: when a failure is covered by both, the line protection plan pays first and the home warranty contract pays only what remains under its own caps.

## How the overlap test is applied

- **What is compared:** the property address of the plan requested against the property address of the plans already on record. The test is decided from Bridgewell's records, before the enrollment is made, and not from the customer's account of what is held.
- **Which existing plans count:** only plans on that address whose status is waiting period, active or suspended for nonpayment. A plan in any of these three statuses counts whichever of them it is in.
- **What makes an overlap:** at least one line type appears both in the covered line types of the existing plan and in those of the plan requested. Each plan's covered line types are those the plan lists.
- **Result of an overlap:** the plan requested is not enrolled.

## Illustrations (hypothetical properties)

| Already on record at the same address | Plan requested | Outcome under the rule |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan, active | Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | The lines differ; the two plans may be held together, each paying its own occurrences under its own caps. |
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan, in its waiting period | Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | Both cover the exterior water service line; the bundle is not enrolled. |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan, suspended for nonpayment | Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | Both cover the sewer lateral and the septic line; the Total Home plan is not enrolled. |

## Moving to a bundle

The single-line plans that overlap the bundle are cancelled first, with the cancellation effective the day before the bundle starts. The bundle then serves its own waiting period for any line that was not continuously covered.

## Line plans and home warranty contracts

A line protection plan and a home warranty contract on the same property may both be held. Where one failure is covered by both, the line protection plan pays first, and the home warranty contract pays only what remains, under its own caps.
